description:
About us and our team

We’re interested in astronomy, visual storytelling, and using creative tools to turn complex ideas into engaging images. For “Abandoned but Not Forgotten: Storytelling About NASA’s Discarded Equipment,” we’d like to tell the story of a piece of NASA equipment that was left behind, retired, or no longer used—and explore the history, people, and mission behind it.

We enjoy developing visual concepts and thinking through how a story can unfold. 

We are a team of 3 girls (12 and 13 years old) + a dad (48 years) old

Roles:

Mia Chan - Sketch artist

Aaardra/Myra - Story board/ Character Cananon/ Research

Sreeram - Technology 

Our research work is at 

https://github.com/lasreeram/nasa_space_app_challenge
